theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the highest-scoring eligible + scorable theme (PPH) with high durability (0.83), full breadth (1.0), a trend-positive Hurst tag, and a confirming val_state. The validated leg here is the absolute-trend gate — eligibility + high durability means the stay-in-trend discipline is intact. Crowding (z=1.42) is elevated but is a sizing caution only, not a fade signal. Momentum rank is a focus lens, not a forecast; the lean leans on the trend-gate staying-power leg plus high breadth/cohesion.
evidence: eligible=true on the validated absolute-trend gate
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.42 and crowded=true means this theme may have already absorbed most of its marginal buyer; reflexivity can unwind a crowded leader faster than expected even when trend-health looks strong. The headline's 'one_narrative=false' also means this is not an isolated, deep leadership — it is competing for flow with three other crowded defensives.

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care EW (XLV proxy) is eligible and scorable with very high durability (0.80), near-full breadth (0.95), and a trend Hurst tag. It shares the same defensive/healthcare staying-power profile as Big Pharma but as a broader, less concentrated expression — slightly less idiosyncratic exposure. Crowding z=1.52 is the main caution. This is a coherence-expressing lean on the same trend-gate leg, lightly held because of overlap with Big Pharma and heavy crowding across the defensive complex.
theses.dissent: This is essentially a diluted version of Big Pharma's crowded defensive trade; if the defensive complex stumbles, this offers no differentiation. Crowding z=1.52 is the highest among top-10 themes — thesis-adoption may already be priced in.
